SELECT B. ID AS RECORDID, B.STAFF_BADGE, B.STAFF_NAME, STAFF.COMP_NAME, STAFF.DEP_NAME, STAFF.JOB_NAME, B.TYPE, B.REST_TIME AS RESTDATE, B.WORK_TIME AS WORKDATE, B.CREATE_TIME AS recordDate, B.CREATE_TIME, B.PROCESS_ID, B.REST_COUNT, B.REST_ABLE_COUNT, B.CAUSE RESTDESC FROM SMT_BREAKOFF_APPLICATION B INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF STAFF ON B.STAFF_BADGE=STAFF.BADGE
B.STAFF_BADGE LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
AND B.STAFF_NAME LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
AND B.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND STAFF.COMP_ID IN ( SELECT DISTINCT SPB.COMP_ID from SMT_PARK_BU SPB
SPB.PARK_ID IN
#{id}
)
ORDER BY B.CREATE_TIME DESC
